title: Japanese-Style Pan-Seared Tempeh
description: A nutritious and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish made with crispy pan-seared tempeh and a hint of irish sea salt.
instructions: 1. Cut tempeh into 1-inch cubes and season with irish sea salt.
2. Heat sesame oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add tempeh to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
4. While tempeh is cooking, combine green onions, daikon, rice vinegar, and honey in a small bowl.
5. Once tempeh is cooked, transfer it to a plate and top with the green onion mixture.
6. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the top of the tempeh.
8. Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
